title: S1000RR M Package (Pro Spec)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Middleweight Sportbike capability, the BMW Motorrad S1000RR M Package (Pro Spec) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
